family.amstrad-ppc.description: Transportable computers with an LCD and full keyboard, differentiated by memory and communications.
family.amstrad-ppc.history: British advertising in February 1988 presented the PPCs as computers for moving between office, home and travel, with the range starting at £399 excluding VAT. They shared an LCD, full keyboard and 3.5-inch floppy drives. The PPC512 was the entry model; the PPC640 added memory and a modem. The service manual documents power from an adapter or ten C cells and versions with one or two drives. Their own screen and keyboard allowed work without a desktop monitor.
